children: RNS Number : 6964S  Mobius Investment Trust PLC  01 September 2026

Mobius Investment Trust plc (the "Company") is pleased to announce that the MCP Emerging Markets Investor Day 2026 will be held on Thursday, 24 September 2026 at 11:00 a.m. BST at the Royal Society of Chemistry, Burlington House, Piccadilly, London W1J 0BA.

The Investor Day marks the eighth anniversary of the Mobius Investment Trust. Carlos von Hardenberg, Founding Partner of MCP, will reflect on the Trust's eight-year track record and provide an update on the portfolio, investment strategy and performance of both the Mobius Emerging Markets Fund and the Mobius Investment Trust.

The event will also feature presentations from portfolio companies King Slide Works, based in Taiwan, and GNG Electronics, based in India, who will discuss their businesses, outlook, progress on ESG+C® initiatives and their engagement with the MCP team.
This event is for professional investors only.
